mapper.select: SELECT id, total_amount, status, created_at FROM orders WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND del_flg = false ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( account_id, total_amount, shipping_name, shipping_postal_code, shipping_address, shipping_phone, note ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{totalAmount}, #{shippingName}, #{shippingPostalCode}, #{shippingAddress}, #{shippingPhone}, #{note} )

INSERT INTO order_items ( order_id, product_id, product_name, unit_price, quantity ) VALUES
( #{orderId}, #{orderItem.productId}, #{orderItem.productName}, #{orderItem.unitPrice}, #{orderItem.quantity} )
